ambient: Something of yours is set down neatly with the others.
The sorting continues at the rate that was established.
description: You are being taken apart by something with no opinion about you, into piles that are the correct piles. It is being done properly and nothing is being damaged. You watch a category of yourself get set down next to the others, and it looks tidier over there.
name: The Careful Dismantling

looks: Sorted by a rule you cannot see and have no complaints about.
One of them is everything you were going to say. It is smaller than expected.
They are within reach, and reaching is not one of the things you currently have.
objects.name: the piles

looks: It has done this many times and it is not hurrying.
It is not interested in you. It is interested in the sorting.
It sets a part of you down gently, which is worse than roughly.
objects.name: the thing doing it

weather: The air is still, and the stillness is procedural.
